title_sq: Dyqan per Shitje te Ministria e Jashtme!
description_sq:
Buze Lanes, te ministria e jashtme, shitet dyqan buze rruges kryesore!
Pozicionohet ne katin perdhe te pallatit. E pershtatshme per aktivitete si: supermarket, restorant, klinike, palester, showroom etj.
Eshte e dhene me qira deri ne Mars te vitit 2027.
Per me shume informacion me kontaktoni!
title_en: Shop for Sale at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs!
description_en: Buze Lanes, at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, a shop for sale on the edge of the main street! It is located on the ground floor of the building. Suitable for activities such as: supermarket, restaurant, clinic, gym, showroom, etc. It is rented until March 2027. For more information, contact me!
